role.monitor: per-epoch evaluation and best-checkpoint selection only
role.locked: single frozen read after all formal checkpoints and prediction hashes are frozen
role.official_test: not constructed, not loaded, not evaluated

data_cache.note: Fit8k / Monitor / Locked all live inside the official-train cache rows; the cache labels are used only for the rows declared above.

baseline_history.model: DCC-L (DualChannel L arm, P3 train-only masked-SSL initialisation)

recipe.selection: strict minimum Monitor MAE (strict <, ties keep earlier epoch)
recipe.normalisation: fit_only_norm over the 8000 Fit8k rows, identical arrays for A and D

model.shared_local_contribution: h_b = phi(c_loc_b); S = sum_b h_b per molecule
model.initialisation_source: historical train-only masked-SSL encoders + historical random P3 group_composer / DCC local_composer; no supervised DCC-L checkpoint is loaded

stop_rule: if A_s0.Monitor > D_s0.Monitor + 0.005 AND A_s0.Monitor > DCCL_s0.Monitor + 0.010: stop
if A_s0.Monitor > DCCL_s0.Monitor + 0.010 AND D_s0.Monitor > DCCL_s0.Monitor + 0.010: stop
pilot.otherwise: train A_s1 and D_s1; no structural, recipe or threshold change after seeing seed 0

decision_rules.noise_floor_reference: historical DCC-L fit8k Monitor spread across 2 seeds = 0.0046207; same-math ZINC run-to-run drift documented in zinc_shared_factor_v1 = up to 0.0026 on valid. Two seeds cannot resolve < 0.003 reliably.
decision_rules.PROMISING_READER_BIAS: both A seeds beat both D and historical DCC-L on Locked; A seed-mean Locked MAE is at least 0.003 lower than D seed-mean AND at least 0.003 lower than DCC-L seed-mean; ordinary-molecule (y > -3) seed-mean gain is >= 0.002 vs both D and DCC-L; the top-10-AE removal seed-mean gain keeps the same (positive) sign vs both; and at least one key group (low-support or any-unseen) has A-vs-D and A-vs-DCCL gains > 0 in both seeds with group seed-mean gain >= 0.003
decision_rules.ADDITIVITY_NOT_SUPPORTED: the A local-contribution pathway is collapsed, or A seed-mean Locked MAE is at least 0.003 worse than D, or at least 0.003 worse than historical DCC-L (checked after PROMISING and before CAPACITY_ONLY)
decision_rules.CAPACITY_ONLY: not PROMISING and not ADDITIVITY_NOT_SUPPORTED; both A and D seed-mean Locked MAE are at least 0.003 lower than DCC-L seed-mean; and A-vs-D is not reliable (|A-D| seed-mean < 0.003 or not all per-seed A-D differences are positive)
decision_rules.INCONCLUSIVE: everything else (seed/tail dependent, or all effects < 0.003)
decision_rules.local_path_collapse: for both A seeds, std(w^T S) < 0.05 * std(psi(G)) AND zeroing w^T S (predicting psi(G) alone) changes Locked MAE by < 0.001; any seed meeting this is reported
decision_rules.official_test_conversion: only if A beats historical DCC-L on Locked by >= 0.005 robustly may the report discuss the distance to official-test 0.05x; no conversion of internal Locked gain into an official-test score is allowed

budget.rule: if projected formal A100-hours exceed 2.0, stop; never shorten total_updates to fit the budget

locked_groups.all_supported: every atom's radius-2 environment occurs in >= 5 Fit8k molecules
locked_groups.low_support: no unseen atom, but at least one atom has Fit8k support 1-4
locked_groups.any_unseen: at least one atom's radius-2 environment has 0 Fit8k molecules

analysis.support_source: Fit8k only; exact typed radius-2 rooted signatures (same construction as zinc_dccl_bottleneck_v1)
analysis.bootstrap: paired over fixed Locked molecules, 10000 resamples, deterministic seed per comparison; descriptive only, not a substitute for seed replication
analysis.top10_sensitivity: drop the 10 molecules with the largest max(AE_A, AE_B) for each pair
analysis.checkpoint_reporting: best_monitor is primary; final is auxiliary only

forbidden: official test or official valid access
using Monitor or Locked labels for architecture / hyper-parameter / epoch / seed selection beyond the declared Monitor checkpoint rule
extra seeds beyond two per new model
per-bond IDs, per-pattern lookup, per-structure memory
new structural statistics, auxiliary supervision, attention, recursion, external data, teacher, ensemble, target-derived features
